text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for this year's summer camp,
which means
long days, hard training,
and improvement in
leaps and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp... Nnngh... We haven't
even left yet
and I'm already getting
dizzy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a little... I think I scheduled too
many
media appointments. I've been
doing like five
shoots a day on the
regular.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫か？疲れたまってる？
大丈夫？疲れたまってる？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Every day, I'm surrounded by people. I
really
appreciate their support, but
everything's been so
non-stop...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh. Is this what it meant?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I saw it through feng shui. A circle of
light with a
little spot of darkness inside
it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that little spot was a sign that I
was about
to get really, really busy.
Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'd been eager to do media work, but
it seems
she bit off more than she could
chew. The best
way to reenergize her
would be...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah. You're right. That might be a
good
idea! I do wanna focus on training.
And...
choice_data_list: 合宿中は取材はなしにしようか

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's something else that's been
bothering me...
a lot.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Look, over there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance away from the gate to see a
familiar
scene unfolding.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Are you really going to quit? I think it's
still too
early for you to give up.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I've got it. Why don't you try a little
good luck
ritual to lift your spirits?
They've been pretty
popular lately.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...There's no point. In the end, the
reason I can't
win is just because I'm not
good enough.
Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There are still so many racers like her.
Ones who
give up because they're lost,
or don't know what
to do.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. I'm going to try reaching out
to some
of them at summer training
camp. Just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hey! You three over there! Is there
anything
you've been worrying about
when it comes to
running?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can help you right out with a little feng
shui! ☆
C'mon, let me know what's been
on your mind!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're... Copano Rickey, right? The
racer
everyone's been talking about
recently? U-um...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
We're not really into that stuff, thanks.
See you.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Acute! Can we talk to you for a
minute? We'd
like some advice about
our training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course, dearies. If there's
anything at all I
can do for you, just let
me know.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, feng shui is really popular right now,
but none
of the Umamusume at Tracen
are even remotely
interested, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Acute's always surrounded
by racers
who want her advice. I hardly
ever see her alone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I wanna make everyone happy! And the people I want to teach feng shui to the most...
choice_data_list: なるほど、気がかりはこれか
なるほど、気がかりはこれ……

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are the ones trying to overcome
whatever
challenge is in front of them. I
mean, they've
gotta be doing the most
worrying too, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There are just as many students
dropping out of
Tracen Academy as
ever. And once they're gone,
the light of
feng shui can't reach them...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating... and really sad. I know
Acute's
advice must be helpful too, but I
just...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Why do you think the
other
Umamusume don't believe in feng
shui?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their clear lack of interest makes me
think there's
something going on that we
don't know about.
choice_data_list: わからない。けど理由はありそうだな
わからない。けど理由はありそうだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we could just figure out what...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm gonna do my best this
summer! I'm
gonna do everything I can
to get them to believe!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And then, once we get everyone to trust
in my
feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We might have to change my own future
plans a
little.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We can shift our focus from racing to
spreading
feng shui far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's how much I care about helping
others with
feng shui. And that's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This summer, I'm gonna give all I've got!
